description:
meetergo connects ChatGPT to your meetergo account. Check availability, book, reschedule or cancel meetings, and manage contacts and routing forms.

Read your website to propose a Mira assistant, configure its knowledge and qualification questions, and test it with simulated visitor conversations. Accounts with the feedback feature enabled can also create questions, read responses and contact eligible respondents.

Connecting is available on every plan, including Free. Individual actions depend on your plan and enabled features; website knowledge crawling requires Growth or higher.
